name: Adako REST API
description:
Adako is an MCP server and REST API for Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, TikTok Ads and
LinkedIn Ads. Every tool an AI assistant can call over MCP is also one HTTP call here, with the
same validation, the same task quota and the same safety rules.

Authenticate with an Adako API key: Authorization: Bearer ak_live_...

Reads run immediately. Writes create a proposal: the response carries proposal_id and
approve_url, and nothing changes on the ad platform until the proposal is approved. Created
campaigns are always paused.

Money is a decimal number in the account currency. Ids are strings.
